description: Comment "Exposed" and I'll send you all the prompts 👇 What happens when you ask Claude to be your therapist? I tried this 4 prompt chain and the results were terrifying. Prompt 1: "Based on everything you know about me from our past conversations, tell me my personality type, my deepest insecurities, the fears I won't admit out loud, and what I actually want in life but I'm too scared to say." Claude flagged things I've never told anyone. Prompt 2: "Tell me the patterns I keep repeating that are quietly destroying my life. Be brutal. Don't soften it." Prompt 3: "Act as my therapist. Based on everything you know, what is the one wound from my past that is still controlling my decisions today?" Claude told me exactly what was holding me back and where it actually started. Prompt 4: "Now reframe it. Give me the exact mindset shift I need and a 30 day plan to actually heal this. Be specific." Claude built me a full step by step healing plan more personalized than any therapist could give. Try this and let me know what it tells you. Disclaimer: This is for self reflection only and not a replacement for professional therapy. If you're struggling, please reach out to a licensed mental health professional. #claude #ai #claudeprompts #selfimprovement #mindset
